email_body:
Dear YEPP Team,

I am writing to apply for the Communications & Events Trainee position at YEPP. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am eager to contribute to your communications efforts and support the organisation of events.

In my current roles, I manage social media content, draft engaging copy for newsletters and websites, and use design tools like Canva to create visuals. I have experience with WordPress, podcast editing, and monitoring social media trends. My political sensitivity is sharpened by my interest in current affairs, and I am confident in my ability to communicate effectively with your audience.

I am fluent in English and native in Turkish, with basic Dutch. I am excited about the opportunity to bring my skills to YEPP and contribute to promoting your values across Europe.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear YEPP Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Communications & Events Trainee position at YEPP. As a digital marketer with a strong foundation in content creation, social media management, and web development, I am drawn to YEPP's mission and the opportunity to support its communications and events activities.

In my freelance work and as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my ability to craft compelling content for various platforms, manage social media accounts, and use design tools such as Canva to create engaging visuals. I have experience in drafting newsletters, updating websites via WordPress, and editing podcasts—skills directly relevant to the responsibilities outlined. My technical background allows me to monitor website performance and suggest improvements, ensuring a seamless digital experience for your audience.

I possess a keen political sensitivity, developed through my engagement with current affairs and my understanding of the European political landscape. I am fluent in English and a native Turkish speaker, with basic Dutch, enabling me to communicate effectively in a multilingual environment. My experience in organising events, though limited, has equipped me with administrative and coordination skills that I am eager to apply and further develop at YEPP.

I am excited about the prospect of contributing to YEPP's communications team, helping to amplify your message and engage with young people across Europe. Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can benefit your organisation.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
• Social media management: created and managed posts across platforms, engaged with online communities, and monitored trends for client websites.
• Copywriting: drafted engaging content for newsletters, website updates, and marketing materials, including SEO blog posts.
• Design and editing: proficient in Canva for visual creation and experienced in podcast editing and WordPress content management.
• Administrative and events support: provided day-to-day administrative assistance and supported event organisation for clients.
• Website management: monitored website performance, implemented edits, and created texts using WordPress and SEO tools.
